rules: A provider_case_ref may be stale or copied forward incorrectly if the activity log says it was reused.
A closed record should not win unless the evidence explicitly says the record should be resumed or reopened.
A client_case_ref may legitimately map to multiple records when a site has multiple similar assets.
Provider aliases inside the same family do not by themselves imply transfer.
A migration relationship across provider families should push toward transfer when other core identifiers align.
When two candidates remain plausible after applying all guardrails, choose duplicate_review instead of guessing.
